EnterpriseDecisionReason.description: Reviewed configuration workflow bound to the exact group graph revision.

GroupSelection.description: Empty means none; all is explicit, tenant-scoped and requires privileged authoring.

EnterpriseResourceRule.description: Canonical complete resource constraint; ANY is explicit privileged scope.

EnterpriseHours.description: Trusted UTC window; end must exceed start.

EnterpriseConditions.description: All present conditions accumulate. Missing trusted evidence denies.

EnterpriseScope.description: A complete group/action/device/resource tuple; independent scopes are never multiplied.

EnterpriseManagementRule.description: Management grants belong to group-assigned Management Roles only.

ControlAgentGroup.description: Tenant-scoped Agent membership and compatible actor/management role assignments.

ControlToolGroup.description: Exactly one primary membership for each Tool; execution bindings are group-level.

ControlAccessGrant.description: Group/typed-role sourced complete runtime capability; never an individual ACL.

ControlDelegation.description: Delegated human operation requires grant and delegation through this same Team and capability through this same Agent Group.

ControlAgentDelegation.description: Bounded downstream Agent Group delegation; every hop narrows capability.

ControlExecutionBinding.description: Explicit Tool Group to Device Group binding; one binding is selected per invocation.

ExtractorField.description: Reviewed JSON pointer to resources, including every batch member or source/destination.

ControlResourceExtractor.description: Reviewed immutable versioned extraction definition; changing it invalidates operation bindings.

ControlWorkloadBinding.description: Individual identity binding is authentication only; permissions derive from Agent Groups.

ControlIdentityBinding.description: Stable verified tenant/issuer/subject identity; email never determines identity.

ControlDeviceEvidence.description: Administrator/attestation sourced facts; callers cannot supply authoritative evidence.

GroupMembership.description: Atomic complete mandatory membership replacement guarded by directory revision.

EnterpriseMemberType.description: Reviewed configuration workflow bound to the exact group graph revision.

EnterpriseActorHop.description: Verified identity/delegation chain entry; not caller-asserted authority.

EnterpriseContext.description: Trusted complete runtime identity. Authentication adapters construct it; ordinary arguments cannot change it. deviceId is the device Control placed the call on: the one online device of the execution binding device group (the user's own first), or the device a human chose.

EnterpriseEvaluation.description: Side-effect-free complete request for simulation or trusted enforcement.

EnterpriseWitness.description: One complete path; Team and Agent Group identifiers cannot be mixed between witnesses.

EnterpriseDecision.description: Deterministic decision, safe reasons, complete witnesses and accumulated obligations.

EnterpriseInvocation.description: Durable exact binding and outcome state. OUTCOME_UNKNOWN never authorizes a blind retry.

EnterpriseSignedPermit.description: Signed enterprise effect permit; claims are bound and consumption is durably atomic.

EnterprisePermitClaims.description: Short-lived audience-bound permit for one exact invocation and target.

EnterpriseSnapshotPayload.description: Signed group graph for discovery and adoption. It is never an execution permit.

EnterpriseApprovalType.description: Reviewed configuration workflow bound to the exact group graph revision.

EnterpriseApprovalState.description: Reviewed configuration workflow bound to the exact group graph revision.

EnterpriseReviewDecision.description: Reviewed configuration workflow bound to the exact group graph revision.

EnterpriseApprovalReview.description: Audited independent review of one bound obligation.

EnterpriseApproval.description: Separate exact-operation and configuration approval records. Reviewers cannot expand the approved binding.

EnterpriseApprovalDecisionRequest.description: Independent decision for one exact operation obligation and approval revision.

EnterpriseInvocationRequest.description: Exact authenticated invocation with original arguments and installed code digests.

EnterpriseReservationRequest.description: Compare-and-swap reservation for a queued invocation.

EnterpriseReservation.description: Durable invocation reservation and its exact signed capability.

EnterprisePermitConsumption.description: Certificate-bound single-use consumption of an exact effect capability.

EnterpriseEffectReport.description: Device-bound durable effect outcome and completed resource subset.

EnterpriseAuthorizationOutcome.description: Online authoritative invocation status. Only a reserved signed permit can proceed to device-authenticated consumption.

InstalledAuthorizationProfile.description: Reviewed deployment metadata, never a grant. Local executors independently verify the installed package and resource extraction definition.

EnterpriseRecoveryAuthorization.description: Protected operator review for group-only bootstrap or bounded recovery.

EnterpriseRecoveryProof.description: Protected operator review for group-only bootstrap or bounded recovery.

EnterpriseReviewedRecovery.description: Initial tenant installation has one pinned installation authority. Existing tenant recovery requires at least two distinct pinned independent signing authorities.

EnterpriseConfigurationState.description: Reviewed configuration workflow bound to the exact group graph revision.

EnterpriseConfigurationCommand.description: Reviewed configuration workflow bound to the exact group graph revision.

EnterpriseConfigurationImpact.description: Reviewed configuration workflow bound to the exact group graph revision.

EnterpriseConfigurationReview.description: Reviewed configuration workflow bound to the exact group graph revision.

EnterpriseConfigurationChange.description: Reviewed configuration workflow bound to the exact group graph revision.

EnterpriseConfigurationPage.description: Reviewed configuration workflow bound to the exact group graph revision.

EnterpriseConfigurationTransition.description: Reviewed configuration workflow bound to the exact group graph revision.

EnterpriseHumanRequest.description: Verified human selects an exact execution binding and target. User and session facts are always supplied by the authenticated adapter.

EnterpriseHumanOutcome.description: Pending approvals carry no queued task or effect capability. Dispatched operations include the durable relay status.

EnterpriseVaultWrite.description: Encrypted secret custody bound to explicit Tool and Device Groups; plaintext never appears in directory export or audit.

EnterpriseVaultReference.description: Visible secret name and group boundary; no plaintext or verifier bytes.

EnterpriseVaultPage.description: Only references covered by the current group management authority are returned.

EnterpriseVaultStored.description: Acknowledgement after authorized encrypted custody and redacted audit commit.

EnterpriseEffectiveMembership.description: Current group membership provenance with intact grants; candidate grants still require the complete request evaluation.

EnterpriseEffectiveAccess.description: Read-only inherited access provenance at the current authority revision. No direct individual access mapping is created. Bindings and candidate grants do not constitute execution authorization.

EnterpriseAdoptionStatus.description: Certificate-authenticated current device acknowledgement. Acknowledgement is metadata, never an execution capability.

EnterpriseAuthorityStatus.description: Saved authority, explicitly published signed snapshot and independently acknowledged device adoption are distinct states.

EnterpriseSecretDeliveryRequest.description: Certificate-bound secret delivery to an executing invocation. Original reviewed resource set must contain this exact secret.

EnterpriseSecretDelivery.description: Runtime-only secret value; never returned by management, export, result or diagnostic routes.

EnterpriseInvocationPage.description: Scoped durable effect states. A cursor does not disclose hidden rows.

EnterpriseReconciliationRequest.description: Immutable independently reviewed downstream evidence. Never creates a new permit.

EnterpriseReconciliation.description: Maker and independent eligible checker resolve an unknown effect; evidence stays external.

EnterpriseReconciliationDecision.description: Independent eligible checker decision against the exact durable reconciliation revision.

EnterpriseShadowRequest.description: Read-only comparison to a captured immutable legacy result; never a second runtime authority.

EnterpriseShadowResult.description: No grant is applied and no approval, quota or permit is consumed.

EnterpriseOperationalStatus.description: Scoped operational health and configured hard bounds. Snapshot lag never authorizes a cached effect.
